name: Ghost Plaza
detailed_description:
Clock in for the night shift at Ghost Plaza!

Play as the new cleaning lady, and your job is not only to clean the whole place up, but also fight the monsters! This will be an adventure featuring:

  • An entire haunted mall to explore

  • Top-down pixel art combat with spooky and silly vibes

  • Multiple weapons and upgrades

  • Lore-filled interactions with NPC ghosts and monsters

  • Chill moments between chaotic battles

Ghost Plaza isn’t just about survival—it’s about exploration. You’re free to roam the entire mall, creeping through quiet food courts, eerie arcades, and cursed clothing stores. Every shop has its own personality, enemies, and surprises—some even hide their own bosses. Whether you’re blasting monsters in the toy store or unraveling spooky secrets in the bookstore, there’s always something weird (and wonderful) waiting behind the next shutter!

short_description: Ghost Plaza is a top-down 2D adventure game with roguelike elements where you have to clean a haunted mall full of ghosts and monsters. Fight creepy creatures, meet weird (sometimes friendly) spirits, and uncover the spooky, silly secrets of the night shift.
